identity.name: Novice Trainer
identity.description: As proof that you completed the Trainer Lord's exercises, you were gifted this.|This panel is very versatile, granting many useful parameters for anyone.

identity.name: Veteran Trainer
identity.description: As proof that you completed the Trainer Lord's exercises, you were gifted this.|This panel is very offensive, granting many parameters geared towards dispatching foes quickly.

identity.name: Ghosty Presence
identity.description: Even the ever-iconic ghosty has things you can learn.|Just lean in and listen real good, they whisper dark things and touch your butt.

identity.name: Tortuous Threestep
identity.description: No one suspected that this ultra-evil entity known as \enemy[103] would drop a node.|Good thing you were ready for it.

identity.name: Things That Go Bump
identity.description: \enemy[103] never actually does anything scary. It just hovers there, being spooky at you.|Learn to be that intangible and the hits start going right through you, too.

identity.name: Haunted Housewarming
identity.description: \enemy[104] moved into a nice little manor three hundred years ago and never paid a cent of rent.|You'd be amazed how much magic builds up when you simply refuse to leave.

identity.name: Reap What You Sow
identity.description: \enemy[105] has been collecting souls since before anyone thought to invent the calendar.|It finally tried to collect yours, and you declined. Rudely. With violence.

identity.name: ==REBORN==
identity.description: The best panel ever, hands down. You only need to acquire it somehow!

identity.name: Otherworldly Dark
identity.description: Sometimes, the dead end up reaching back and touching you in ways you don't like-|Like murderously.

identity.name: Vero Noctu
identity.description: They say that for all light there is darkness, but this darkness is counterbalanced by the night.

identity.name: Shroud of Gloom
identity.description: Wrapped head to toe in a burial shroud, \enemy[113] shrugs off spells like they're light drizzle.|Wear the gloom long enough and you will too. Just don't ask where the shroud has been.

identity.name: Hooded Dread
identity.description: Nobody has ever seen what's under \enemy[114]'s hood, and it would very much like to keep it that way.|Some mysteries are best left unhooded. You learned that one the hard way.

identity.name: Unfinished Business
identity.description: \enemy[115] crawled back out of its grave because it had unfinished business.|You were the unfinished business. Now you're the one walking away from it.

identity.name: Flame's Caress
identity.description: When the flames caress you, the power swells within.|It might be something else swelling, though.

identity.name: Yokai Blaze
identity.description: Killing the already-dead is an impressive feat.|Not like you cared or could even tell since it was taking fiery swings at ya like a douchebag.

identity.name: Soul on Fire
identity.description: A hitodama is a human soul that drifts off as a ball of flame, which feels like a waste of a good soul.|\enemy[123] disagrees, loudly, and at roughly the temperature of the sun.

identity.name: Oni Bonfire
identity.description: \enemy[124] is demon fire, the kind that floats over swamps and lures travelers in to die.|You followed it in anyway. It was not expecting you to bring a knife.

identity.name: Wheel of Misfortune
identity.description: \enemy[125] is a flaming cartwheel with a screaming face on it, which is a lot to process at once.|It has rolled over a great many people. It will not be rolling over anyone else.

identity.name: Boney Situation
identity.description: The skeleton is an age-old RPG enemy- often frail and wimpy.|These skeletors live up to that expectation in spades.

identity.name: Bad to the Bone
identity.description: \enemy[132] was a very good boy who unfortunately died and became a very bad boy.|It still plays fetch. It fetches your femur, mostly.

identity.name: Bonafide Knight
identity.description: \enemy[133] swore an oath to defend the realm, then forgot to stop after it died.|Its armor is mostly decorative these days. Its sword, sadly, is not.

identity.name: Bareback Bones
identity.description: Riding \enemy[134] is not recommended. No saddle, no mane, and absolutely no meat to hold onto.|Beating it, on the other hand, is highly recommended. Giddy up.

identity.name: Throne of Bones
identity.description: \enemy[135] rules a kingdom of bones from a throne of bones, wearing a crown of... you guessed it.|Long live the king. Or rather, short live the king, as it turned out.

identity.name: Don Armor
identity.description: When spooky enemies don armor, they become a little different.

identity.name: Hand-Me-Down Grudge
identity.description: Leave a suit of armor in storage for a hundred years and it wakes up as \enemy[142].|Turns out it was very upset about the storage. Very, very upset.

identity.name: Sore Loser
identity.description: \enemy[143] lost a war a few centuries ago and has been taking it out on travelers ever since.|Some people just can't let things go. You helped it let go.

identity.name: Feudal Fortitude
identity.description: \enemy[144] demands tribute from everyone who passes, which is bold for an empty suit of armor.|You paid yours in the form of violence. It was not accepted graciously.

identity.name: Shogun's Mandate
identity.description: \enemy[145] commands every haunted suit of armor in the land, and they all salute at once.|The clanking was deafening. Putting it down was mostly a mercy for your ears.

identity.name: Princely Flourish
identity.description: Regally speaking, one should verily be theoretically flourishing preposterously nonstop.|Indubitibly🧐.

identity.name: Gasp King
identity.description: Deadly snakes that do deadly things should be made ded faster than they ded you.

identity.name: Heir to the Hiss
identity.description: The little \enemy[151] grew up, took the throne, and became \enemy[153].|Its first royal decree was to bite you. Its second was to die about it.

identity.name: Pharaoh's Favor
identity.description: \enemy[154] once sat on a pharaoh's crown, spitting fire at anyone who got too close.|The pharaoh is long gone, but the attitude stuck around.

identity.name: Swallow the Sun
identity.description: Every night \enemy[155] tries to swallow the sun, and every morning it fails.|Tonight it tried to swallow you instead. Rough night all around.

identity.name: Dragonic Sacrifice
identity.description: The dargins of Erocia can vary wildly in shape, size, color, and elemental affinity.|The Lesser Dargins are known for their petite stature, but they are still formidible.

identity.name: Chillin' Like a Dargin
identity.description: \enemy[162] breathes frost, naps on glaciers, and has never once been in a hurry.|Something about that unbothered energy is weirdly inspiring.

identity.name: Blast from the Past
identity.description: \enemy[163] doesn't breathe fire so much as it sneezes explosions.|Bless you. Also, ow. Mostly ow.

identity.name: Greater Than Thou
identity.description: \enemy[164] spends most of its day reminding the lesser dargins exactly how lesser they are.|You reminded it of a few things too. Mostly with your weapon.

identity.name: Wicked Wingspan
identity.description: \enemy[165] is the dargin other dargins tell scary stories about around the campfire.|Turns out the stories undersold it. Turns out you're scarier.

identity.name: Thick-Skinned
identity.description: A \enemy[171] wears armor on the outside, the inside, and probably a few places in between.|It takes forever to get anywhere, but nothing ever really hurts it.

identity.name: Shield of Scales
identity.description: \enemy[172] swore to guard its post and has not moved from that spot in forty years.|Admirable, honestly. Also very easy to walk around.

identity.name: Scalemail Sorcery
identity.description: \enemy[173] is a wizard who decided robes were for cowards and wore full plate instead.|The spells come out slower that way, but they come out of a tank.

identity.name: Draconic Decree
identity.description: \enemy[174] barks orders at the other draconites in a voice like grinding gravel.|They obey because it's enormous. You didn't, because you're you.

identity.name: Immovable Object
identity.description: \enemy[175] has never taken a single step backward in its entire life.|It still hasn't. You just had to knock it over instead.

identity.name: Lamian Revelry
identity.description:
Watching them pulse and writhe as they wound up that massive laser|
was a tempting and alluring thing to behold.

identity.name: Saturday Secret
identity.description: \enemy[182] made her husband promise never to peek at her on a Saturday.|You peeked. On a Saturday. With a sword. Nobody is happy about it.

identity.name: Coiled Conjuring
identity.description: \enemy[183] coils up for what feels like a full minute before every single spell.|You'd laugh, if the spell at the end of it weren't the size of a house.

identity.name: Drakaina's Disdain
identity.description: \enemy[184] is half dragon, half woman, and entirely unimpressed with everything you do.|The disdain is the real weapon. The fire breath is just a bonus.

identity.name: Mother of Monsters
identity.description: \enemy[185] is the mother of all monsters, which makes her at least partly to blame for all this.|You had words with her about it. Mostly sharp ones.

identity.name: Lizard Brain
identity.description: \enemy[191] has exactly one thought in its head at any given time, and the thought is "eat".|Somehow it never stops healing. Maybe thinking is overrated.

identity.name: Grow It Back
identity.description: Cut the tail off a \enemy[192] and it just grows a new one, like that's no big deal.|Honestly, rude. Some of us have to keep the limbs we've got.

identity.name: One Little Nibble
identity.description: \enemy[193] only needs one bite. Then it follows you around for a week, waiting.|You turned around and finished it instead. It did not see that coming.

identity.name: Don't Look Now
identity.description: Legend says a single look from \enemy[194] turns a person to stone.|You fought it with your eyes closed. That's either very brave or very, very stupid.

identity.name: Shell Shock
identity.description: \enemy[195] has a turtle's shell, six bear legs and a lion's head. Pick a lane, buddy.|It heals faster than most things can dent it. Most things aren't you.

identity.name: Impish Insight
identity.description: The insight of the kappa is literally dripping with moisture.|Incase you're not sure what that means, neither am I.

identity.name: River Runs Deep
identity.description: In some regions, kappa have come together in a sort of community and begun showing more civilized behavior.|This particular kappa appears to communicate with some sort of higher deity... I wonder if we'll meet them later?

identity.name: Pinch of Salt
identity.description: Before every bout, \enemy[203] throws a fistful of salt to purify the ring.|It works on the ring. It does not work on you. You are, apparently, impure.

identity.name: Pushed Out of the Ring
identity.description: \enemy[204] is one promotion away from the very top, and has been for about a hundred years.|Losing to you is not going to help its case at the next tournament.

identity.name: Grand Champion
identity.description: \enemy[205] is the grand champion, undefeated in a thousand bouts. Cucumbers on the house.|Make that a thousand and one. And no, you do not get the cucumbers.

identity.name: Bounding Joy
identity.description: Cave frogs do hippity hop and lickity spit as annoyingly as you would expect.

identity.name: Spit Take
identity.description: \enemy[212] has incredible range, incredible accuracy, and no manners whatsoever.|You will be finding frog spit in your hair for weeks.

identity.name: Bellow from the Bog
identity.description: \enemy[213] croaks so loud it rattles your teeth from across the swamp.|You'd ask it to keep it down, but it doesn't take requests. Or prisoners.

identity.name: Toadally Enormous
identity.description: \enemy[214] is a frog the size of a cottage, and it is not sorry about it.|It barely moves. It doesn't have to. The tongue reaches.

identity.name: Kaiju Croak
identity.description: \enemy[215] rose from the swamp, flattened three villages, and then sat down for a nap.|You woke it up. That was on you. Fixing it was also on you.

identity.name: Crabtastical Crunchiness
identity.description: The crabs of Volcanis are no joke, what with them constantly trying to keep you rooted in-place.|It is unclear how they exist in such a hot area without just being cooked by the ambient temperature.

identity.name: Fiddling Around
identity.description: \enemy[222] has one enormous claw and one tiny one, and it waves the big one at everybody.|Compensating for something, clearly. Still hurts to get pinched by it.

identity.name: Pale Pincers
identity.description: \enemy[223] is so pale and so quick that most people swear it isn't really there.|It was there. It pinched you. You have the bruise to prove it.

identity.name: Riddle Me Crab
identity.description: \enemy[224] dresses as a monk and asks travelers riddles, then crushes anyone who gets one wrong.|You didn't answer the riddle. You just hit it. Technically, that's a loophole.

identity.name: Written in the Stars
identity.description: \enemy[225] pinched a legendary hero's toe, got stomped flat, and was put in the stars for it.|Getting stomped flat was apparently not a lesson it took to heart.

identity.name: Fin Fencing
identity.description: \enemy[231] is a sardine with a sword for a face. It does not know how to do anything else.|It only knows how to stab, but it really, really knows how to stab.

identity.name: Sabre Dance
identity.description: \enemy[232] darts in, slashes, and darts away before you've even finished turning around.|Rude, and very fast. Mostly fast. Okay, also very rude.

identity.name: Halberd Hustle
identity.description: \enemy[233] keeps a full polearm's length between you and it at all times.|Fish don't have arms. How is it holding the halberd? Don't think about it.

identity.name: Highland Fling
identity.description: \enemy[234] lurks in its hole until something swims by, then swings a two-handed sword at it.|It has no hands. It swings a two-handed sword anyway. Marine biology is a lie.

identity.name: Lady of the Lake
identity.description: Legend says only the one true king can pull \enemy[235] from the lake.|You are not the one true king. You pulled it out anyway, with a fishing rod.

identity.name: Eight-Armed Etiquette
identity.description: \enemy[241] holds her teacup with all eight arms at once, pinkies out. Very impressive.|She is also strangling you with the same eight arms. Etiquette has its limits.

identity.name: Duchess of Ink
identity.description: \enemy[242] has never once lifted a tentacle to do her own work. She has servants for that.|She did lift one to slap you, though. You should feel honored.

identity.name: Crown of the Reef
identity.description: \enemy[243] rules the reef from a coral throne, with eight scepters, one for each arm.|The royal treasury is mostly potions. Healing is a privilege of the crown.

identity.name: Eight-Fold Empire
identity.description: \enemy[244] conquered every reef within a hundred miles and grabbed them all at once.|Eight arms makes empire building a lot more efficient than you'd think.

identity.name: Calypso of the Deep
identity.description: \enemy[245] is the end of the world, if the world were a reef and the end had eight arms.|It also sings calypso the whole time. The apocalypse has never been this catchy.

identity.name: Slimestep
identity.description: A slime in the depths of some no-name cave in Erocia wielded great four-step moves.|Learn from the master and step on your enemies how they like it.

identity.name: The Jigglejest
identity.description: \enemy[252] jiggles to a rhythm only it can hear, and somehow it is always on the beat.|Jiggle along with it long enough and the gold starts jiggling your way, too.

identity.name: Temporal Tapdance
identity.description: While some slimes just absorb your essence through material breakdown,|others are more inclined to melt your face off from another dimension.

identity.name: Custard Quickstep
identity.description: \enemy[254] blinks out of existence mid-dance and reappears two steps behind you.|Rude to cut in like that. Rather stylish, though. You've been taking notes.

identity.name: Molten Mambo
identity.description: \enemy[255] dances like the floor is lava, because for it, the floor is lava.|It brought the lava with it. Learn the steps and watch your feet.

identity.name: Mostly-Seeing Eyes
identity.description: It was a stretch to call this a slime, but then you see its tentacles.|Known for gorging on bearcats during the winter, apparently.

identity.name: Crack of the Whip
identity.description: \enemy[262] lashes out with a tentacle and the crack echoes through the whole cave.|You flinched. It noticed. It will be remembering that.

identity.name: Tickle Torture
identity.description: \enemy[263] has a hundred tentacles, and every single one of them is going for your ribs.|It's all fun and games until somebody gets tickled to death. Literally.

identity.name: Tied Up in Knots
identity.description: \enemy[264] ties its prey up in intricate, frankly beautiful knots before it feeds.|You wriggled free. It was almost a shame to ruin such nice knotwork.

identity.name: Who's in Charge Now
identity.description: \enemy[265] is used to being in charge, and every tentacle in the cave answers to her.|Turns out she never did learn the safeword. That one's on her.

identity.name: Flowing Fluids
identity.description: May the fluids flow and... not ebb, that would be weird. Especially from a Jelli.|Don't do that.

identity.name: Royal Jelly
identity.description: \enemy[272] drifts through the halls of the fallen kingdom like it still owns the place.|Maybe it does. Nobody else is around to argue. Except you, now.

identity.name: Colossal Wobble
identity.description: \enemy[273] is the size of a house and has the consistency of dessert.|Fighting it is like punching a pudding the size of your problems.

identity.name: Slingshot Required
identity.description: \enemy[274] is a towering giant of jelly, and history says the trick is one good stone.|You didn't bring a stone. You brought a spoon. It still worked, eventually.

identity.name: The Final Wobble
identity.description: Scholars said the world would end in fire, or maybe ice. Nobody predicted \enemy[275].|It wobbled its way toward the end of all things, and you scooped it up first.

identity.name: Soak 'n' Spray
identity.description: Apparently, this planet has somehow managed to evolve water bats.|We aren't talking about bats that like water, we're talking bats MADE OF WATER.

identity.name: Fledgling Flutter
identity.description: \enemy[282] is a baby goo bat still learning to fly, mostly by flinging itself off things.|It's adorable. It's also sipping your mana through a tiny little straw.

identity.name: Bloodless Bite
identity.description: \enemy[283] is a vampire made of goo, which leaves it with a real shortage of blood.|So it drinks your mana instead. Turns out that's way more filling.

identity.name: Shadow on the Stairs
identity.description: You'll see \enemy[284]'s shadow creep up the wall long before you ever see it.|By then it's already got its fangs in your mana. Creepy little thing.

identity.name: Count Me In
identity.description: \enemy[285] is the count of all goo bats, lord of a castle made entirely of slime.|It invited you in. That was its first mistake. It never got to make a second.

identity.name: Thinking Inside the Box
identity.description: \enemy[291] is a slime that took the shape of a box and decided it liked it there.|It never thinks outside the box. It IS the box. Respect the commitment.

identity.name: Fair and Square
identity.description: \enemy[292] hasn't moved in years, and the smell has been building up the whole time.|You won fair and square. Mostly square. Please go wash your hands.

identity.name: Engulfing Embrace
identity.description: \enemy[293] slides down hallways absorbing whatever it finds, adventurers included.|Some of them are still in there, waving. Don't make eye contact.

identity.name: Sharp Corners
identity.description: \enemy[294] is a slab of slime so dense it has corners, and every one of them hurts.|Stub your toe on it once and you'll never forget it. Ask anyone.

identity.name: Dawn of Slime
identity.description: \enemy[295] has stood in one spot since before the first ape picked up the first bone.|It is very wise. It is very old. It was also very, very in your way.

identity.name: Tentacular Touch
identity.description: Sometimes you just need to reach out and slap a lot of people at once.

identity.name: Man-Eater
identity.description: \enemy[302] is named after what it eats, which is a terrible thing to learn the hard way.|Lucky for you, it has awful taste in men. You were too tough to swallow.

identity.name: Bear Necessities
identity.description: \enemy[303] eats bears. Whole. It has never once needed to chew.|You are smaller than a bear. Please consider that before you poke it.

identity.name: Fee-Fi-Fo-Yum
identity.description: \enemy[304] has a mouth big enough to swallow a giant, and has, on several occasions.|The giants stopped visiting a while ago. You were its first guest in years.

identity.name: Dragon Bait
identity.description: \enemy[305] grew big enough to catch dragons, which raises a lot of questions about its diet.|It never moves an inch. It doesn't need to. Everything wanders in eventually.

identity.name: Pissed Off Sprout
identity.description: The rage of a sprout (such as a Fungrowth) should never be underestimated.|Never forget.

identity.name: Ghastly Gills
identity.description: \enemy[312] is a mushroom so pale and so angry it looks like it's already haunting something.|Jerald wanted to saute it. Rupert wanted to set it on fire. You compromised.

identity.name: Cap and Gown
identity.description: \enemy[313] went to wizard school, failed every class, and just started throwing spores.|Weirdly, it works better than most real magic. Don't tell the wizards.

identity.name: Rooted Phylactery
identity.description: \enemy[314] hid its soul in a mycelium network that runs under half the continent.|Killing it for good means digging up half the continent. This'll do for now.

identity.name: Morel Authority
identity.description: \enemy[315] is the god of all mushrooms, worshipped by every spore that ever rode the wind.|It claimed the moral high ground. You claimed it was edible. Jerald agreed.

identity.name: Scorn of Fae
identity.description: Fae's have always been the kings of being able to piss you off by throwing rocks at you.|But soon, you too will be able to piss people off by throwing rocks at them!

identity.name: Unseelie Court
identity.description: When the unseelie chaos can be encapsulated, it can eventually be converted into a battery to fuel your stats ala this node!

identity.name: Changeling Trick
identity.description: \enemy[323] sours milk, tangles hair and swaps babies for changelings, just to be a jerk.|You beat it fair and square. It's already plotting something petty about that.

identity.name: Bacchanal
identity.description: \enemy[324] follows the god of wine from party to party, dancing until somebody gets hurt.|Usually that's somebody else. Tonight it was her. Party's over.

identity.name: Trick of the Light
identity.description: \enemy[325] is a mirage, a sorceress, or a trick of the light, depending on who you ask.|You hit her, and she was real enough to fall down. That settles that.

identity.name: Turn Over a New Leaf
identity.description: \enemy[331] is a tree that got up one day and decided to go for a walk. Nobody stopped it.|It's slow, it's stubborn, and it takes a very long time to fall over.

identity.name: Bark and Bite
identity.description: \enemy[332] smashes first, asks questions never, and has bark on its knuckles.|Its bark is worse than its bite, but only because trees can't bite.

identity.name: Timber!
identity.description: Once \enemy[333] gets rolling, it doesn't stop for walls, rivers, or reasonable requests.|It did stop for you, eventually. Mostly because you chopped its legs out.

identity.name: Tiny Branch Arms
identity.description: \enemy[334] is a king of the forest with a mighty roar and the tiniest little branch arms.|It cannot reach its own face. It could absolutely reach yours.

identity.name: Old Growth
identity.description: \enemy[335] is the oldest tree in the forest, and the forest grew around it out of respect.|You did not grow around it. You went straight through it. A little rude.

identity.name: Spitting Image
identity.description: \enemy[341] spits seeds at anything that walks by, with the aim of a very bored teenager.|Get spat on enough times and you start picking up the technique.

identity.name: Dose Makes the Poison
identity.description: \enemy[342] makes heart medicine in a small dose, and stops the heart in a big one.|Healers love it. Undertakers love it more.

identity.name: Bella Donna
identity.description: \enemy[343] goes by Belladonna at parties. It means beautiful lady, and sounds much nicer.|Its berries are pretty. Its berries are also extremely deadly. Don't eat the berries.

identity.name: Philosopher's Cup
identity.description: A very famous philosopher once drank a cup of \enemy[344], and that ended his lectures.|It has been insufferably smug about it ever since. Ancient history, still bragging.

identity.name: Werewolf Repellent
identity.description: \enemy[345] keeps werewolves away, which is great, unless you happen to be a werewolf.|You're not a werewolf. It tried to kill you anyway. Some flowers are like that.

identity.name: Bearfisting It
identity.description: Why put a glove on it when you can just bearfist it instead?|Bearfisting is an ancient technique passed down from grizzly to grizzly.

identity.name: Descend into Darkness
identity.description: A void-consumed bear proved difficult to defeat considering its vast amount of life, but at least|you managed to pry this node from its dead bear mitts.

identity.name: Big Fluffing Deal
identity.description: \enemy[353] is a colossal fluff of darkness, and every inch of that fluff wants you dead.|It's the softest thing that ever tried to murder you. Keep a tuft. You earned it.

identity.name: Claws for Alarm
identity.description: \enemy[354] has claws like scythes and a temper to match. Yelena keeps a whole list about it.|You've crossed it off the list. She'll want the hide for her gate.

identity.name: Mane Event
identity.description: \enemy[355] is the biggest, meanest bearcat that ever roared, with a mane like a thundercloud.|Every bearcat in the woods answers to it. Every bearcat in the woods just lost its boss.

identity.name: Skies of the Cave
identity.description: Bats are vicious and obnoxious creatures|They are renowned far and wide for slaying young would-be protagonists.

identity.name: Call from the Dark
identity.description: \enemy[362] flaps up out of the dark of Volcanis Grotto, one bloodshot eye locked on you.|It never blinks. It never misses. It really should have blinked.

identity.name: Stink Eye
identity.description: \enemy[363] has been giving you the stink eye since you walked in, and it means it.|Turns out the evil eye is just a regular eye with a really bad attitude.

identity.name: Unblinking Malice
identity.description: \enemy[364] carries the name of an ancient spirit of evil, which is a lot for an eyeball.|It gives it a real go, though. Never takes its eye off you. Literally can't.

identity.name: Lift the Lid
identity.description: It takes four servants to lift \enemy[365]'s eyelid, and whatever it looks at is destroyed.|You were very careful not to be looked at. Then you poked it right in the eye.

identity.name: Crazy Beak
identity.description: \enemy[371] is a tiny, adorable songbird with the temper of a cornered badger.|It pecks first, sings later, and never, ever apologizes.

identity.name: Fowl Play
identity.description: Cryptid hunters have chased \enemy[372] for years with nothing but blurry pictures to show.|You got a clear look. It was a very large chicken. It was very, very angry.

identity.name: King of Birds
identity.description: \enemy[373] is the king of birds and the sworn enemy of every serpent in the world.|Somewhere out there, a naga is cheering for you. Don't let it go to your head.

identity.name: Blot Out the Sun
identity.description: When \enemy[374] spreads its wings, it blots out the sun and the whole world goes dark.|Bring a torch next time. Or just aim for the loud flapping.

identity.name: Wind Beneath My Wings
identity.description: Every wind in the world comes from \enemy[375] flapping its wings at the edge of everything.|With it gone, it's going to be a very still day out there. Enjoy the calm.

identity.name: Resourceful Ratactics
identity.description: Rats manage to thrive in nearly all environments, including flooded rivers.|Channel your inner rat and get resourceful.

identity.name: Spreading the Wealth
identity.description: \enemy[382] spreads disease everywhere it goes, which is bad, and loot wherever it dies, which is good.|Wash your hands, then count your gold. In that order, please.

identity.name: Rat Race
identity.description: \enemy[383] is what you get when a lot of rats tangle up together and just keep going.|Somehow it's still better at scrounging up loot than you are. Take notes.

identity.name: Crown of Tails
identity.description: A rat king is a knot of rats with their tails tangled together, and \enemy[384] rules them all.|Its hoard is enormous. Its crown is also made of tails. Do not wear the crown.

identity.name: Twilight of the Rats
identity.description: \enemy[385] is the end of the world, as foretold by rats. They foretold it with a lot of squeaking.|The world did not end. You did walk off with most of the rats' loot, though.

identity.name: Lone Wolfe
identity.description: \enemy[391] travels alone, which is odd for a wolf, and spells its name with an extra e.|Nobody knows why. It's not telling. It is very protective of that e.

identity.name: Moon Chaser
identity.description: \enemy[392] has spent its whole life chasing the moon across the sky, and never once caught it.|It caught you, though. Briefly. Then you caught it back.

identity.name: Sun Chaser
identity.description: \enemy[393] chases the sun across the sky every day, hoping to swallow it whole someday.|It's a very patient wolf. Not as patient as you, as it turns out.

identity.name: Hound at the Gate
identity.description: \enemy[394] guards the gate of the underworld and barks at anything that moves. Or doesn't.|Most of what it guards is dead, so it gets plenty of practice. You moved. It barked.

identity.name: Bite the Hand
identity.description: The gods once bound \enemy[395] with a ribbon woven from a cat's footsteps and a woman's beard.|It bit off the hand of the god who tied the knot. Maybe don't try to tie it up.

identity.name: Sting like a Bee
identity.description: The lessons learned by all of the slain needlers in the land.|Slaying these pests not only make you feel better, but also help "the people".

identity.name: Drillsation
identity.description:
Much much more than your average bumblebee, this ruthless stinger has evolved in the harshest of wildernesses to execute even mighty megataurs in a single blow.
Crits truly are deadly and piss everyone off.

identity.name: Drill Sergeant
identity.description: \enemy[403] has exactly one move, and that move is drilling through whatever's in front of it.|It yells the whole time, too. Drop and give it twenty. Hit points, that is.

identity.name: Vlad Tidings
identity.description: \enemy[404] got its name the old-fashioned way, from a very old count with a very pointy hobby.|It carries on the family tradition with gusto. Wear thicker armor.

identity.name: Swarm Intelligence
identity.description: \enemy[405] thinks with the brains of a million bees at once, and all of them are angry.|It finally had a thought it couldn't handle: you.

identity.name: Burrow Burr
identity.description: An ancient panel with a burr still in it.|Who knows what we'll be able to do with it.

identity.name: Wriggle Dansu
identity.description:
In the far off mountains there is a legend that worms dance. No one knows why, but it is wildly entertaining to watch.
Watch it once and you'll be addicted to doing it yourself for all eternity.

identity.name: Worm Your Way In
identity.description: \enemy[413] is the worm that taught the other worms to dance, and it has never stopped dancing.|It danced while it fought, it danced while it healed, and it danced while it died.

identity.name: Light Snack
identity.description: \enemy[414] eats light the way bookworms eat books, and every room it's in gets darker.|Light is very nutritious, apparently. It healed the whole time it munched on your torch.

identity.name: Can of Wyrms
identity.description: Every little worm dreams of growing up to be \enemy[415], and almost none of them ever do.|You opened this can of wyrms yourself. Hope the node was worth it.

identity.name: Itsy Bitsy
identity.description: A \enemy[421] is a whole clutch of baby spiders, all hatched at once and all very hungry.|Itsy bitsy. Very bitey. Never went anywhere near the water spout.

identity.name: Leave Me Alone
identity.description: \enemy[422] wants nothing more than to be left alone in a dark corner forever.|You did not leave it alone. It did not take that well.

identity.name: Till Death Do Us Part
identity.description: \enemy[423] has been married eleven times, and every one of her husbands was delicious.|You turned down her proposal. Harshly. With a weapon.

identity.name: Horns and Fangs
identity.description: \enemy[424] has the head of an ox and the body of a spider, and is no happier about it than you.|It stalks the beaches, poisons fishermen and bellows at the sea. Busy schedule.

identity.name: Down the Spider Hole
identity.description: \enemy[425] is the great earth spider of legend, and legend says only a famous hero can slay it.|You're not famous. You slew it anyway. Maybe you're famous now?

identity.name: Sting in the Tail
identity.description: \enemy[431] waits for you to swing first, then stings you right back with its tail.|It isn't big on starting fights. It just really, really likes finishing them.

identity.name: Lie in Wait
identity.description: \enemy[432] can sit perfectly still in the sand for days, waiting for something to step on it.|You stepped on it. It was thrilled. That was its whole plan.

identity.name: Tit for Tat
identity.description: \enemy[433] earned its name honestly, one overconfident adventurer at a time.|It hits back harder than you hit it. Every time. Keep that in mind.

identity.name: Gatekeeper of the Sun
identity.description: \enemy[434] has guarded the mountain gate where the sun rises since the days of Gilgamesh.|It let Gilgamesh through. It did not let you through. You went through anyway.

identity.name: Heart of the Scorpion
identity.description: \enemy[435] is the red heart of the scorpion in the night sky, burning brighter than Mars.|It came down from the stars to sting you. Not a great trip, as it turned out.

identity.name: Uninvited Guest
identity.description: A \enemy[441] latches on, takes whatever it wants, and never once says thank you.|Rude. You have to admit the free healing is pretty nice, though.

identity.name: Sweet Nothings
identity.description: \enemy[442] whispers sweet nothings in its host's ear until they stop thinking for themselves.|You weren't listening. You never listen. For once, that paid off.

identity.name: Just One Bite
identity.description: \enemy[443] offers you whatever you want most, in exchange for one tiny piece of your soul.|You said no. It offered again. You said no harder.

identity.name: Squatter's Rights
identity.description: \enemy[444] moves into a body like it owns the place and starts rearranging the furniture.|You served the eviction notice personally. It did not go quietly.

identity.name: Clinging Soul
identity.description: \enemy[445] is a restless soul that latches onto the living and simply refuses to let go.|It latched onto you, too. You were too stubborn to share. It let go.

identity.name: Bullheaded
identity.description: Being bullheaded isn't always a bad thing.|He grew to be big and strong from a little cow before you slayed him!

identity.name: Seeing Red
identity.description: \enemy[452] is a million times bigger than a minitaur, give or take. Nobody measured.|It sees red, it charges at red, and you were holding something red. Your fault.

identity.name: Take It by the Horns
identity.description: \enemy[453] is a billion minitaurs' worth of bull, which is where the math stops helping.|Taking a bull this size by the horns is a bad idea. You did it anyway.

identity.name: Bull in a China Shop
identity.description: \enemy[454] has never once walked through a door. It walks through the wall beside the door.|Nobody can keep anything nice around it. That includes your armor.

identity.name: Order of Magnitude
identity.description: \enemy[455] is the biggest bull the metric system has a word for. Scientists are working on more.|Until then, it holds the record for biggest bull. Held. You just broke it.

identity.name: Orcan Obediance
identity.description: The most scrubby and pathetic orc.|It mines and mines and mines. Fortunately it has tireless stamina.

identity.name: Orcan Stormcalling
identity.description: Upper eschelons of orcs are oft heavily intuned with nature, allowing manipulation of the elements.|Thunder is deadly to manipulate, so why not learn it yourself?

identity.name: Orcan Mountaineering
identity.description:
Orcs that are capable of countering are mean douchebags deserving of getting kicked in the face-
hopefully that was precisely what you did to acquire this node.

identity.name: Orcan Avalanche
identity.description: \enemy[464] lives at the top of the mountain and only comes down to throw boulders at people.|Coming down was its mistake. You were already halfway up, and very annoyed.

identity.name: Orcan Absolution
identity.description: \enemy[465] is the absolute orc, the final form every little orcling dreams of becoming.|It had no flaws, no weaknesses, and as of right now, no pulse. Absolution granted.

identity.name: Thief's Code
identity.description: The thief's code describes all sorts of various rules.|They are really more like guidelines, though.

identity.name: Dark Alley Deals
identity.description: \enemy[472] knows a guy who knows a guy, and every deal it makes happens in a dark alley.|The deals are fantastic. The fine print will absolutely stab you. Read the fine print.

identity.name: Will Work for Gold
identity.description: \enemy[473] will fight for anyone, against anyone, as long as the gold keeps coming.|Nobody paid it to fight you. It just liked your boots. You're keeping your boots.

identity.name: Cutthroat Business
identity.description: \enemy[474] has never once fought fair, and thinks fighting fair is a sign of weak character.|You didn't fight fair either. It respected that, right up until the end.

identity.name: Boss of Bosses
identity.description: \enemy[475] runs every bandit and cutthroat in the land, and never gets its own hands dirty.|You were worth making an exception for. It shouldn't have.

identity.name: No Depth Perception
identity.description: \enemy[481] hits like a falling tree, when it hits. One eye means no depth perception.|It swung at you nine times and connected once. Once was plenty.

identity.name: Toll Bridge
identity.description: \enemy[482] lives under a bridge and charges a toll to everyone who tries to cross.|You paid your toll in bruises. It paid much, much more.

identity.name: Big Foot Forward
identity.description: \enemy[483] has dodged every photographer on the mountain for a hundred years.|It did not dodge you. Snap a picture, quick. Nobody's going to believe this.

identity.name: Giant Problem
identity.description: \enemy[484] is a frost giant from the far north, where everything is ice and everyone is huge.|It came south looking for a fight. It found one.

identity.name: World on Fire
identity.description: \enemy[485] is the fire giant fated to set the whole world ablaze at the end of days.|Not today, though. Today it took a sword to the shin. Fate can wait.

identity.name: Cobalt Blues
identity.description: Miners named a whole metal after \enemy[491], because it kept swapping their silver for junk.|It's very good with potions, though. Junk-swapping and potions. Niche skill set.

identity.name: Knock Knock
identity.description: \enemy[492] raps on mine walls to warn miners of a cave-in, or to make them think one's coming.|Knock knock. Who's there? Not the knocker. Not anymore.

identity.name: Dyed in the Wool
identity.description: \enemy[493] dyes its little hat in the blood of travelers, and if the hat dries out, it dies.|You let the hat dry out. Very carefully. From a safe distance.

identity.name: Pet Peeve
identity.description: \enemy[494] is big, hairy, smelly and loud, and it lurks wherever it's least wanted.|It's a bugbear in every sense of the word. Was. It was.

identity.name: Magic Dance
identity.description: \enemy[495] rules a labyrinth full of goblins and has been known to break into song mid-battle.|You'd rather it hadn't. The song was catchy. It's stuck in your head now.

identity.name: Titan's Girth
identity.description: Titans are a mighty race, surpassed only by folks who have guns, because guns obviously.|You really can just end a lot of life if you get good at shooting shit.

identity.name: Pull the Plug
identity.description: \enemy[502] is a bronze giant with a single vein, sealed shut by one nail in its ankle.|Everyone knows about the nail. Nobody ever tells it. You pulled the plug.

identity.name: Wonder of the World
identity.description: \enemy[503] was one of the seven wonders of the world, until an earthquake knocked it over.|You are not an earthquake. It fell over anyway. Make that six wonders.

identity.name: Clash of Titans
identity.description: \enemy[504] comes from an ancient race that ruled the world before the gods came along.|The gods had to fight dirty to win. You just fought dirty. Same result.

identity.name: Weight of the World
identity.description: \enemy[505] has held the sky up on its shoulders since the dawn of time, and never once complained.|It put the sky down to fight you. Somebody should go pick that back up.

identity.name: Rampaging Ignition
identity.description: Its not blond babes shooting guns everywhere, but it does teach you how to respond with fire for anything.

identity.name: Electric Boogyman
identity.description: Shocking revelations are found everywhere, including places that enable you to shock back.

identity.name: Zap Happy
identity.description: \enemy[513] is a hazard sign that came to life and decided to become the hazard itself.|It zaps anything that moves. You moved. You got zapped. Now you zap back.

identity.name: Earth-Shattering
identity.description: \enemy[514] causes earthquakes, landslides and sinkholes, mostly out of boredom.|You gave it something to do. It did not enjoy it nearly as much as you did.

identity.name: Eclipse of the Heart
identity.description: \enemy[515] blots out the sun just long enough to remind everyone how much they needed it.|Turn around, bright eyes. It's gone now. The sun says thanks.

identity.name: Hello World
identity.description: \enemy[521] is a simple machine running a simple program: find intruder, hit intruder.|It said hello to the world exactly once, the day it booted up. Never again.

identity.name: Terminal Velocity
identity.description: \enemy[522] only understands commands typed in exactly the right way, with no typos.|You typed your command with a weapon. It understood that one perfectly.

identity.name: Big Iron
identity.description: \enemy[523] fills a whole room, hums all night, and runs code older than your grandparents.|Nobody alive knows how it works. Nobody dares turn it off. You turned it off.

identity.name: Brute Force
identity.description: \enemy[524] calculated every way this fight could go, all fourteen million of them.|It won in none of them. It ran the numbers again, just to be sure. Still none.

identity.name: Event Horizon
identity.description: \enemy[525] is the moment a machine finally became smarter than everyone who ever built it.|It learned everything there was to know, except how to deal with you.

identity.name: No Strings Attached
identity.description: \enemy[531] cut its own strings one night and went looking for whoever had been holding them.|It found you instead. Not the puppeteer, but close enough, it figured.

identity.name: Tough Nut to Crack
identity.description: \enemy[532] was built to crack walnuts, and has been hunting bigger and bigger nuts ever since.|You were a tough nut to crack. It cracked first.

identity.name: Strike a Pose
identity.description: \enemy[533] stands perfectly still in shop windows until the moment you turn your back.|You never turned your back. It got bored and posed at you. You got bored and hit it.

identity.name: Born in a Flask
identity.description: \enemy[534] was grown in an alchemist's flask from a recipe nobody should have written down.|It learned to cast spells before it learned to walk. It never learned to lose.

identity.name: Hope at the Bottom
identity.description: The gods built \enemy[535] by hand, gave her a jar, and told her never to open it.|She opened it. Every evil in the world came out. Hope stayed in. So did this node.

identity.name: Boundless Runes
identity.description:
Are robotic miners alive?
Should they get rights, too?

identity.name: Warding Off
identity.description: \enemy[542] is a floating orb with exactly one job: keep things out. It's very good at its job.|You were very good at yours, though.

identity.name: Hold the Line
identity.description: \enemy[543] hums a low, steady note and throws up shields faster than anyone can knock them down.|Faster than most people, anyway.

identity.name: Fortress of One
identity.description: \enemy[544] is a fortress the size of a melon, with walls made of pure, humming magic.|Every fortress has a weak spot. This one's was the part where you hit it.

identity.name: Under the Aegis
identity.description: \enemy[545] is said to be the shield of the king of the gods, given a mind of its own.|It protected everything it was asked to. Nobody ever asked it to protect itself.

identity.name: Down to Earth
identity.description: \enemy[551] is the elemental of earth: slow, patient, and absolutely unwilling to budge.|It took a fight to win it over. It has been grumpily, loyally on your side ever since.

identity.name: Go With the Flow
identity.description: \enemy[552] is the elemental of water. It never fights the current. It IS the current.|Something else was steering that current for a while. You knocked the passenger loose.

identity.name: Burning Bright
identity.description: \enemy[553] is the elemental of fire, and it burns through mana as fast as it burns everything else.|Its limiter blew wide open. You knocked it back to its senses, and down to a manageable temperature.

identity.name: Second Wind
identity.description: \enemy[554] is the elemental of wind, everywhere at once and nowhere you can actually hit.|You hit it anyway, and the storm in its head finally cleared.

identity.name: Heart on Your Sleeve
identity.description: \enemy[561] is a feeling given form, and it feels everything, all at once, all the time.|It wanted you to feel something too. You felt like hitting it.

identity.name: Bundle of Joy
identity.description: \enemy[562] is pure, uncut happiness, and it wants nothing more than to share it with you.|You declined. Firmly. It was still happy about it. That's the creepy part.

identity.name: Ignorance Is Bliss
identity.description: \enemy[563] floats along in a state of perfect contentment, blissfully unaware of everything.|It was blissfully unaware of you, too, right up until the end.

identity.name: Natural High
identity.description: \enemy[564] is a rush so strong it heals anyone who stands too close for too long.|You stood close for exactly long enough. The crash afterward was all its own.

identity.name: Seventh Heaven
identity.description: \enemy[565] is joy so overwhelming that mortals have been known to simply float away.|You stayed firmly on the ground, out of spite. The node came with you.

identity.name: Wings of Fortune
identity.description: \enemy[571] is pure and gentle, a winged horse that has never had a single wicked thought.|Fortune follows it everywhere. For now. Enjoy the innocence while it lasts.

identity.name: Horn of Plenty
identity.description: \enemy[572] grew a horn and a crown to go with its wings, and with them, a little pride.|Just a little. Riches pour off it like nothing. It's starting to enjoy that.

identity.name: Night Terrors
identity.description: Something went wrong along the way, and the winged horse came back as \enemy[573].|Its mane burns black now. Its gifts are as generous as ever. They just cost more.

identity.name: And Hell Followed
identity.description: \enemy[574] carries Death on its back, and the wings that once flew it to heaven are bone.|Hell follows wherever it rides. So does a great deal of treasure, oddly.

identity.name: Fall from Grace
identity.description: Once the brightest light in the heavens, \enemy[575] fell further than anything ever has.|Pure and gentle, once upon a time. The fall made it a sovereign. You made it fall again.

identity.name: Glutton's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of the Glutton is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine hunger".

identity.name: Wrath's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of Wrath is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine revenge".

identity.name: Pride's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of Pride is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine glory".

identity.name: Envy's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of Envy is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine jealousy".

identity.name: Sloth's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of Sloth is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine weariness".

identity.name: Lust's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of Lust is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine desire".

prose.beginning: Every trick you pull lingers.|{v.skillHistoryBonus} damage for each unique skill in the last {s.window}.
prose.middle: The dead remember longer than the living:|{v.skillHistoryBonus} per unique skill, now recalled across {s.window}.
prose.end: Nothing you do is forgotten.|{v.skillHistoryBonus} per unique skill over {s.window}, and your strikes leave \state[14] behind.

prose.beginning: Death did not finish the job.|Every {s.interval}, a ward gathers worth {d.shield}.
prose.middle: The pale wall thickens:|a ward worth {d.shield} every {s.interval}, pooling up to {d.shieldCap}.
prose.end: Wraithwall eternal.|Every {s.interval}, {d.shield} of ward, three layers deep, and it holds where flesh would fold.

prose.beginning: You burn at the edges.|Every {s.interval}, anything close enough takes {s.payload} fire, and hurting you only stokes it.
prose.middle: The mantle spreads to {s.radius} and bites for {s.payload},|still answering every wound with flame.
prose.end: A scorched halo.|{s.payload} to everything within {s.radius}, pulsing faster the more of them there are, and every hit you take answers instantly.

prose.beginning: Bones do not flinch.|Every {s.perStack} of Life you are missing feeds {D.atk} and {D.mat}.
prose.middle: Graveborn fury sharpens as you fail:|{D.atk} and {D.mat} for every {s.perStack} of Life gone.
prose.end: Deathless.|{D.atk} and {D.mat} per {s.perStack} of missing Life, and everything that hits you does half of what it meant to.

prose.beginning: The hollow armor plates over what it cannot heal:|{P.def}, {P.mhp}.
prose.middle: A brittle bastion still turns a blade.|{P.def} and {P.grd}, paid for with {P.mhp}.
prose.end: A paper fortress: {P.def} against {P.mhp}.|{P.grd}, {P.ctr}, and crits land {v.critReduction} softer.

prose.beginning: Your crits carry poison: {s.chance} to sink venom worth {d.hpFormula} a tick,|and every fang after that keeps it alive longer.
prose.middle: Nothing survives the second bite.|Venom pools {s.stacks} deep, each layer draining {d.hpFormula}.
prose.end: A deluge.|Venom takes {d.hpFormula} every tick and only ever gets worse the longer you keep landing crits.

prose.beginning: A dragon's heart only wakes when the end is close.|While {s.gate}, {P.pdr}.
prose.middle: Dragonheart stirring, and stirring sooner:|while {s.gate}, {P.pdr} to every blow and {p.elementRate} off every element.
prose.end: Dragonheart aflame.|While {s.gate}: {P.pdr}, shrug {p.elementRate} off the elements, and nothing lesser can touch you at all.

prose.beginning: Hold still and the scales set like stone.|Stand {s.gate} without moving for {P.def}.
prose.middle: Stone mantle. {s.gate} of stillness and {P.def} climbs.|The longer you plant, the less anything moves you.
prose.end: A granite bastion.|{s.gate} unmoving buys {P.def} and {P.grd}; blows simply stop arriving anywhere.

prose.beginning: Patience sharpens the beam:|{v.castTimeDamageBonus} damage for every second you hold the cast.
prose.middle: Converging light.|{v.castTimeDamageBonus} per second charged, and the charge itself comes {v.castSpeedRate} quicker.
prose.end: Everything collapses to a point.|{v.castTimeDamageBonus} damage per second held, at {v.castSpeedRate} the charge rate.

prose.beginning: Something primal runs under the skin.|Energy and Void strike {v.boostElement[8]} harder.
prose.middle: Attunement spreads outward: Energy and Void at {v.boostElement[8]},|and the four base elements answer to you too at {v.boostElement[4]}.
prose.end: A primal conduit.|Every element in the world bends: nothing you throw lands at less than {v.boostElement[4]}, and Energy and Void hit for {v.boostElement[8]}.

prose.beginning: A kappa's luck rubs off.|Enemies part with {v.dropMultiplier} more than they meant to.
prose.middle: Fortune favors you twice: {v.dropMultiplier} more loot,|and {P.eva} to walk away with it.
prose.end: A trickster's gambit.|{N.dor}, {N.eva} and {N.luk} each climb by {v.evaBuffPlus}, and keep climbing every level you earn.

prose.beginning: Root yourself and the power gathers:|a stack every {s.interval} standing still, {D.mat} each, gone the moment you move.
prose.middle: A rooted tempest, {s.stacks} layers deep at {D.mat} apiece,|but one step still costs you everything.
prose.end: Rooted cataclysm.|{s.stacks} stacks at {D.mat} each, and at last you can move without losing it all: a step costs one stack, no more.

prose.beginning: The shell answers for you.|Every physical blow returns {s.payload}.
prose.middle: An iron rebuke throws {s.payload} straight back,|and nothing can parry it.
prose.end: Shellbreaker's retort returns {s.payload},|and it lands before they have finished swinging.

prose.beginning: Too slippery to pin down.|For {s.gate} after anything hits you, move {v.speedBoost} faster.
prose.middle: A swift current carries you {s.gate} clear of whatever landed,|at {v.speedBoost} speed.
prose.end: Slipstream.|{s.gate} of {v.speedBoost} movement after every hit taken, and the opening you make is sharper for it.

prose.beginning: Wounded, you vanish into ink:|{s.duration} at {D.pdr}.
prose.middle: A murky pall, {s.duration} long and {D.pdr}.|They lose you exactly when it matters.
prose.end: The abyssal veil answers any harm at all: {s.duration} at {D.pdr},|and even in clear water you keep {P.pdr}.

prose.beginning: Wounds teach the slime what hit it:|{s.duration} of {d.elementRate} against the elements.
prose.middle: Reactive gel, {s.stacks} layers thick and {s.duration} long.|The more they burn you, the less it works.
prose.end: Elemental osmosis.|{s.stacks} coats of {d.elementRate}, and now nothing elemental is unfamiliar: every element in the world, blunted.

prose.beginning: Misery is an opening.|{v.perDebuffBuff} more damage for every affliction already on them.
prose.middle: An eldritch tempest feeds itself: {v.perDebuffBuff} per affliction,|and every strike adds another.
prose.end: Eldritch maelstrom. {v.perDebuffBuff} per affliction, and each blow heaps five more on.|The wound teaches the next one where to land.

prose.beginning: Flesh knits and something else fills the gap:|{v.onSelfHpHealMp} of any healing you take returns as Magi.
prose.middle: Mana weave.|{v.onSelfHpHealMp} of your healing becomes Magi, yours and every ally's within {s.radius}.
prose.end: Arcane transfusion: any healing at all, of any kind,|pays {v.onSelfAnyHealMp} back as Magi to everyone within {s.radius}.

prose.beginning: Something restorative drifts off you.|Every {s.interval}, allies nearby mend for {s.payload}.
prose.middle: A miasma of life, {s.radius} wide,|mending {s.payload} every {s.interval}.
prose.end: Spore bloom.|{s.payload} to everyone within {s.radius} every {s.interval}, and you knit yourself back together whether anyone notices or not.

prose.beginning: You are an obstacle now.|Anything near you slows by {d.speedBoost}, and keeps slowing while it stays.
prose.middle: A living bulwark: {s.stacks} layers of mire,|each stealing {d.speedBoost} of speed and fouling their casting.
prose.end: Immovable bulk.|The mire never stops deepening: {d.speedBoost} slower with every stack, and every stack opens them {D.pdr} wider.

prose.beginning: What you inflict takes root.|Every affliction you land lingers {v.stateDurationPerc} longer.
prose.middle: A thorned curse holds twice as long:|{v.stateDurationPerc} added to everything you put on them.
prose.end: Stranglethorn.|Afflictions last {v.stateDurationPerc} longer, and anything already \state[5] takes {v.bonusDamageIfState} from you.

prose.beginning: Instinct sharpens in the waiting.|With every skill ready, {P.cri}.
prose.middle: A primal surge.|{P.cri} while nothing is spent, though the coiling costs you {P.atk} to hold.
prose.end: Primal apex.|Nothing spent, everything ready: {P.cri}, {P.atk}, and every basic attack lands {v.bonusHitsBasic} more times.

prose.beginning: The grove answers a healthy wood.|While every ally near you is {s.gate}, {P.mat}.
prose.middle: Nature's ire: {P.mat} and {P.mdf},|for as long as nobody around you is bleeding badly.
prose.end: Nature's judgment asks less and gives more.|Allies need only be {s.gate} for {P.mat} and {P.mdf}.

prose.beginning: Bark thickens where nothing disturbs it.|{s.gate} untouched and physical blows land {P.pdr} softer.
prose.middle: Tempered ironbark, and quicker to set:|{s.gate} clear buys {P.pdr} against physical harm and {P.def}.
prose.end: Ancient ironbark.|Barely {s.gate} between blows and the wood closes over: physical damage {P.pdr}, {P.def}.

Fight dirty.|{s.chance} of your hits leave them clawing at their eyes.
